text: No fire was detected on the asset during the evaluated period (2026-09-23 to 2026-10-23). NASA FIRMS data showed zero thermal anomalies within the asset boundary, with full coverage from multiple sensors (VIIRS_SNPP, VIIRS_NOAA20, VIIRS_NOAA21, and MODIS) every day. However, this does not rule out small, short-lived, or obscured fires, as they may not be detected. The evidence also does not confirm the presence of burned areas or the cause of any potential changes. Observability was complete, but limitations in detection methods mean we cannot definitively confirm no fire occurred.
